essence: A wondrous shower of flowers is produced in the sky by those moving beings.
The deity is visualized as having gone individually between each of the two pairs of women.
The deity, covered with rising hair, is repeatedly likened to a betel-vine tree.
Adorned with all ornaments making charming sounds, the deity becomes captivating to the heart.
The lord is visualized seated on a red lotus upon a very extensive jeweled conch.
